description: Find Naukri.com jobs by keyword, location, company or job ID and return full job details, salary information, skills and company profiles.

browserFallback.description: If the normal connection is blocked, retry through a browser session. Slower and uses more memory; leave off unless needed.
browserFallback.title: Browser Fallback

companyIds.description: Naukri company IDs to search across. When searches are also supplied, each company is combined with every search.
companyIds.title: Company IDs

failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run as failed when no jobs are returned.
failOnEmpty.title: Fail When No Jobs Found

includeCompanyReviews.description: Include up to three AmbitionBox review snippets per job. Off by default to keep records small.
includeCompanyReviews.title: Include Company Reviews

includeDescription.description: Include the full job description text. Turn off to keep records smaller.
includeDescription.title: Include Full Description

includeDescriptionHtml.description: Include the raw HTML job description in addition to plain text.
includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include Description HTML

jobIds.description: Fetch these Naukri job IDs directly. Accepts bare IDs or Naukri job URLs. Job IDs are processed before searches.
jobIds.title: Job IDs

maxItems.description: Total records to return across all queries. Naukri allows at most 3,000 jobs per query (150 pages of 20).
maxItems.title: Max Items

onlyNew.description: Emit only jobs that were not emitted by an earlier run with the same state key.
onlyNew.title: Only New Jobs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional connection override. By default the actor uses an India-based Apify connection automatically.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

resetState.description: Clear the saved job IDs before this run.
resetState.title: Reset Incremental State

searches.description: One or more search configurations. Each entry can hold several keywords and several locations; every keyword is combined with every location. Leave keywords empty to browse a location or company.

companyId.description: Optional Naukri company ID (numeric, e.g. "10111"). Free-text company names are not supported by Naukri.
companyId.title: Company ID

experienceYears.description: Return jobs whose experience range includes this many years (0-30).
experienceYears.title: Experience (years)

jobAge.description: Only jobs posted within the last N days. Promoted jobs can bypass the server filter; strictJobAge removes them.
jobAge.title: Job Age

keywords.description: Job titles or search terms (e.g. "software engineer", "data scientist").
keywords.title: Keywords

salaryBucket.description: Annual salary band in Indian lakhs. Naukri can include jobs with hidden salary in a band; use salaryDisclosed to separate them.
salaryBucket.title: Salary Bucket

workMode.description: Remote or hybrid filter. Naukri does not expose an office-only filter; "any" returns every mode.
workMode.title: Work Mode

searches.title: Search Queries

stateKey.description: Optional name for the incremental state. Defaults to a hash of the search configuration.
stateKey.title: Incremental State Key

strictJobAge.description: Drop promoted jobs older than the selected job age using Naukri's posting date.
strictJobAge.title: Strict Job Age

timeBudgetSecs.description: Stop gracefully after this many seconds. 0 means no time limit.
timeBudgetSecs.title: Time Budget (seconds)

title: Naukri Job Scraper Input
